Summary: Define a milestone contract with the sponsor
Description: As a creator or sponsor, I want to jointly define the deliverable description, due date and escrow amount for each milestone.
Acceptance Criteria: Given both parties confirm the milestone details, when the contract is saved, then the agreed description, due date and escrow amount are visible to both parties.

Summary: Submit a draft deliverable for review
Description: As a creator, I want to submit a milestone draft so that the sponsor can review it before payment release.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an active milestone, when the creator uploads a draft, then the submission is recorded, a watermarked preview is made available, and funds remain locked pending sponsor approval.

Summary: Automatically watermark uploaded image and video drafts
Description: As a creator, I want image/video drafts watermarked before sponsor preview so that preview content is protected.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an image or video draft is uploaded, when preview processing completes, then only the watermarked preview is shown to the sponsor and processing meets the 5-second NFR target under a defined test workload.

Summary: Review and approve a submitted milestone draft
Description: As a sponsor, I want to review and approve a draft that meets the agreed milestone terms.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a submitted draft, when the sponsor approves it, then approval/sign-off is recorded against the milestone and the milestone becomes eligible for payment release.

Summary: Reject a draft with written revision comments
Description: As a sponsor, I want to reject a draft with written comments so the creator knows what to revise.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a submitted draft, when the sponsor rejects it with comments, then the milestone enters Pending Revision, funds remain locked, and the creator is notified.

Summary: Release escrow payment after sponsor approval
Description: As a creator, I want locked milestone payment released only after sponsor approval/sign-off.
Acceptance Criteria: Given sponsor approval is recorded, when release is initiated, then the platform requests release of the corresponding locked amount; without approval, release is denied and funds remain locked.

Description: As the platform, I need to process an approved milestone payment transaction so the release is executed and traceable.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an eligible approved milestone, when the transaction is processed, then its result and reference are recorded; a failed or uncertain transaction is not marked paid.

Summary: Raise a dispute after two draft rejections
Description: As either creator or sponsor, I want to raise a dispute after two rejections so an unresolved disagreement receives neutral review.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the milestone has reached two rejections, when either party raises a dispute, then escrow funds are frozen and the case is routed to the neutral Escrow Moderator for recorded resolution.

Summary: Maintain encrypted escrow data and append-only audit events
Description: As a platform operator, I need encrypted escrow wallet data and an append-only log of lock/release/refund events.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a lock, release or refund occurs, when the event is committed, then the log contains timestamp, actor ID, milestone ID and transaction reference; escrow wallet data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
